All three describe one mechanism: the floor at :260 is denominated over `totalPhUSD = amount + mintedForStable`, of which `amount` is minted unconditionally at :263, so `totalPhUSD >= amount` always and the predicate `totalPhUSD < minPhUSDOut` is unsatisfiable for every minPhUSDOut in [0, amount].

CODE-001 is the mechanism, ECON-001(degraded) is the value consequence that makes the mechanism matter, F-05 is the Law-2 provenance of the design choice that produced the mechanism. Filing them separately would put three entries in front of a triager for one patch - the exact dilution the quality bar rejects.

DIFFERENT MITIGATION. `if (mintedForStable == 0) revert PhUSDNotReceived();` after :256 - protocol-side, not caller-waivable, and orthogonal to the floor's unit.
